agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Toor called the regular March 4, 2003 meeting of the Boulder City Council to order at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers.

agenda_items.title: CITIZEN PARTICIPATION and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council asked for information from the January 19 th Water Rates public meeting to be included in the packet for 2 nd Reading of the Monthly Water User Charges and Conservation Measures Ordinance (Ordinance #7270) scheduled for the March 18 th council meeting.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried, 8:0, Councilmember Morzel absent.

agenda_items.title: APPROVAL OF CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES FROM FEBRUARY 11, 2003.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried, 8:0, Councilmember Morzel absent.

agenda_items.title: APPROVAL OF CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES FROM FEBRUARY 18, 2003.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried, 8:0, Councilmember Morzel absent.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE No. 7266 AMENDING SECTIONS 3-5-2 AND 3-5-5, B.R.C. 1981, CONCERNING FOOD TAX REFUNDS.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried, 8:0, Councilmember Morzel absent.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE No. 7268 AMENDING TITLE 4, “LICENSES AND PERMITS,” B.R.C. 1981, BY ADDING A CHAPTER 26, “CEMETERY PERMITS,” AND AMENDING TITLE 8, “PARKS, OPEN SPACE, STREETS, AND PUBLIC WAYS,” B.R.C. 1981 BY ADDING A NEW CHAPTER 8-7, “CEMETERIES.”
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Toor removed item 3D from the Consent Agenda and was continued to the March 18 th meeting.

UPDATE REGARDING THE ECONOMIC VITALITY ACTION GROUP.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: City Manager Bruno informed Council that at the first meeting the rather narrow scope of the six month effort which is to suggest tools, strategies and alternatives that might assist in enhancing business opportunities and sales tax revenues was described to the group.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 7:0; Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Mock to approve consent items 3A through 3C.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried, 8:0, Councilmember Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Havlick, to approve the draft letter of opposition to RTD regarding the proposed elimination of the Neighborhood and Business Eco pass programs.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 8:0, Councilmember Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Riggle moved, seconded by Ruzzin, to adopt Resolution No. 924 regarding the City's position on the Boulder Valley School District's proposed school closures and consolidations.

Mayor Toor offered a friendly amendment, accepted by the maker and seconder of the motion, to ask Boulder Valley School District to work with the City of Boulder to evaluate opportunities to use Education Excise Tax funds and to house community activities in schools to create a financially feasible way to keep Neighborhood schools open.

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Ruzzin to accept staff recommendations #1 and #2 and by the first meeting in June to have #3 and #4 come back as well as an analysis of the Education Excise Tax rate and potential future needs.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:1; Havlick opposed; Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Corson to approve Ordinance No. 7267 amending Ordinance No. 6080 (1999) designating the Downtown area as a historic district under the city of Boulder Historic Preservation Code. The proposed amendment will amend the boundaries of the Downtown Historic District to include the property at 2121 Broadway.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:0 as amended to correct "Hillside to Downtown" in the ordinance ; Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Ruzzin moved, seconded by Mock to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7269 approving supplemental appropriations to the 2003 Budget as amended.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6:1; Havlick opposed, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Ruzzin to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7270 amending Section 4-20-25, "Monthly Water User Charges" and Section 11-1-49, "Water Conservation Measures," B.R.C. 1981, to increase the treated water quantity charge for inside and outside city water and to establish a surcharge during a drought.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:0; Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7271 adopting Supplement No. 75 which codifies previously adopted Ordinance Nos. 7227, 7233, 7234, 7235, 7240, 7242, 7243, 7247, 7248, 7252, and 7254 as an amendment to the Boulder Revised Code 1981, and setting forth details in relation thereto.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:0; Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Ruzzin moved, seconded by Mock to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7272 amending Ordinance No. 5896 (1997) by revising the impasse resolution procedure utilized when the city reaches impasse with one of its bargaining units.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:0; Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 11:45 P.M..
